hard_constraints: Use Legends EU continuity only; no Disney Canon elements.

Force description must be experiential and body-first: tactile low vibration without physical source, fractional distance error in Force perception (handrail six inches further, slight parallax, low-grade disorientation); no diagnostic terms like 'Weave', 'unweaving', or analysis before sensation.
Terminology: datapad (not laptop/computer), blaster (not gun), etc.; per anachronistic_terms and style_constraints.
Jedi reporting: Ben transmits to Luke as Grand Master via standard hierarchy; report includes visuals/tool-marks/age but omits Force impression.
Mild thin place effects per force_mechanics: Force responds but misplaced; Desh: nothing overt, possible unsourced unease.
No color/visual for wrongness; tactile/vibrational only, one consistent metaphor per scene.
Ben does not theorize withholding motive; omission is behavioral action.
canon_risks: Risk of non-Legends construction styles for ruins; must align with authorized AU (Ruusan Corridor/anchor node remnants) without contradicting Jedi Lords/NSW era.
Risk of over-diagnosing Force anomaly early; keep pre-Ch9, no 'thin place' naming or Weave vocabulary.
Ben's Force-sense must remain Legends-standard (intuitive, moral-polar) with AU mild distortion only.
legends_continuity_notes: Ben Skywalker: Jedi Knight, post-Fate of the Jedi/Abeloth, experienced in GAG/GA service; conducts Outer Rim surveys as routine Jedi fieldwork.

Jedi surveys: Knights catalog anomalies (archaeological, Force) via datapad scans, transmit to Temple/Council/Grand Master; protocol prioritizes verifiable data over subjective impressions unless corroborated.
Force with artifacts: Touch can evoke echoes/residue (e.g., KOTOR/Malachor precedents); here limited to mild parallax per plan.
Pre-Republic/Jedi Lords era: Ruusan Reformations (1000 BBY) post-NSW; ruins evoke that era's military installations, not earlier unless authorized lineage.
Outer Rim worlds: Often uncharted/low-traffic, recent surveys (60 years) plausible but incomplete.
possible_disney_bleed: Avoid kyber crystal or Inquisitorius references (none in plan).
No High Republic terminology/institutions (plan ruins are NSW-era AU).
required_context_for_drafter: Setting: Unnamed Outer Rim arid/rocky world, half-buried ruins older than 60-year survey; low civilian traffic (freighter contrail).

Emotional: Curiosity -> unease -> quiet alarm; advances Ben/Desh to co-investigators, Ben/Luke first withholding.
AU thin place: First encounter, very mild; plants H02 (anomalous ruins pattern).
